metadata.dataset: NASA Mars Exploration Program & Mars Architecture

description: Conquer Jezero Crater. Overcome 15-minute comms delays, atmospheric dust storms that smother solar arrays, extract oxygen with MOXIE, and grow crops in Martian greenhouse soil.

levels.title: Mars Level 1: Jezero Delta & MOXIE Oxygen

objectives.description: Construct 1 Pressurized Surface Habitat Alpha in Jezero Crater
Deploy 1 MOXIE Atmospheric CO2 Solid Oxide Electrolyzer
Extract and accumulate >= 200 kg breathable O2 from Martian CO2 air
Maintain positive power grid (>= 3.0 kW) accounting for Mars solar flux (586 W/m²)

tutorialSteps.title: Welcome to Jezero Crater, Mars (18.38°N, 77.58°E)
tutorialSteps.instruction: Radio telemetry from Earth experiences an 852-second (14.2 minute) speed-of-light delay. Due to solar distance (1.52 AU), solar panels generate only 43% of lunar flux.
tutorialSteps.whyThisIsReal: Radio travels at c = 299,792 km/s. Mars-Earth distance ranges from 54.6M km (3.0 min) to 401M km (22.3 min). Inverse-square law: 1361 / (1.524)^2 = 586 W/m².

tutorialSteps.title: MOXIE Solid Oxide Electrolysis (SOXE)
tutorialSteps.instruction: Deploy the MOXIE module. MOXIE intakes thin 95% CO2 atmospheric gas, compresses it to 1 atm, and heats it to 800°C to split CO2 into CO + O2.
tutorialSteps.whyThisIsReal: NASA Mars 2020 Perseverance MOXIE completed 16 successful runs on Mars, producing 122 grams of 98% pure oxygen directly from atmospheric CO2.

realDataReference.title: NASA Mars 2020 MOXIE & Jezero Delta Science
realDataReference.source: NASA Mars 2020 Perseverance / MIT MOXIE Team (Hecht et al., Science Advances 2022)
realDataReference.explanation: MOXIE demonstrated that scalable solid oxide electrolysis can produce breathable oxygen and rocket oxidizer directly from Mars's carbon dioxide atmosphere, eliminating the need to haul oxidizer from Earth.

realDataReference.title: Mars 2020 Perseverance Science at Jezero
realDataReference.source: NASA Mars 2020 Mission (Farley et al., Science 2020)
realDataReference.explanation: Jezero crater preserves evidence of an ancient river-fed lake. MOXIE demonstrated generating oxygen from the thin 95% CO2 atmosphere.
